examples.title: Button
examples.description: When the button is pressed the onboard led (at least for the ESP32) will turn on. It will turn of when the button is released.

examples.title: DHT Sensor Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller should display the temperature and humidity in the console. This information is collected from a DHT11 or DHT22 sensor.

examples.title: I2C BMP280 Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller reads the temperature and pressure from the connected BMP280 sensor and prints it on the terminal.

examples.title: I2C Compass (GY-271) Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller reads the magnetic field from a GY-271 or HW-246 compass module and prints the three axes and a heading in degrees.

examples.title: I2C Liquid Crystal Display Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller should display some text on a Liquid Crystal Display (16x2) over I2C. Keep in mind that the LCD needs an I2C Backpack for this example to work.

examples.title: I2C MPU-6050
examples.description: In this example the microcontrollers reads values from the MPU-6050 accelerometer and gyroscope. It also reads the onboard temperature sensor of the module.

examples.title: VCNL4040 Sensor Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller reads proximity and ambient light from a VCNL4040 sensor, printing the light level in lux and reporting when something comes near.

examples.title: I2C RTC (DS3231) Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller reads the date, time and temperature from a DS3231 real time clock module, and copies the time into the board's own clock so it survives a reset.

examples.title: I2C Scanner Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontrollers scans for devices connected over I2C and displays them to the user on the console.

examples.title: TOF10120 Sensor Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller should display the distance that the sensor has measured. This value has a maximum of 2000.

examples.title: VL6180X Sensor Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller measures the distance to a nearby object with a VL6180X time of flight sensor, checks whether the reading is valid, and also prints the ambient light level.

examples.title: IR Remote (NEC) Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller decodes button presses from an infrared remote control with a 38kHz receiver module, prints which button was pressed and toggles the onboard LED.

examples.title: IR Remote Send (NEC) Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller sends NEC remote control codes from an infrared LED, using the ESP32's RMT peripheral where it exists and a PWM carrier everywhere else.

examples.title: Matrix Keypad (4x4) Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller reads a membrane matrix keypad, collects the digits typed into a code, and checks it when the hash key is pressed.

examples.title: P9813 RGB LED Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller shows the plain colours on a chain of P9813 RGB LEDs and then cycles a rainbow along it.

examples.title: PWM
examples.description: This example will show you how to create a fading LED animation with a PWM Signal.  This example can of course also be used to control servo's, motor drivers, buzzers, analog output, etc.

examples.title: PWM Servo (DM-S0306D) Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller sends a PWM signal to control a 360 degree servo's. Further documentation about the dutycycle and frequency can be found inside the code.

examples.title: Seven Segment Display (74HC595) Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller drives a single 7-segment display through a 74HC595 shift register, counting 0 to 9 and then through the hex letters, using three pins instead of eight.

examples.title: SPI LED Matrix (MAX7219) Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller shows text on a chain of MAX7219 8x8 LED matrix modules and scrolls a message across them.

examples.title: SPI RFID RC522 Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller reads the id of any MIFARE card or tag held against an RFID-RC522 reader, and prints the contents of one block from it.

examples.title: SPI ST7789 Display Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller should display some text on a ST7789 240x240 Display over SPI.

examples.title: TM1637 7-Segment Display Example
examples.description: In this example the microcontroller writes numbers and text to a TM1637 four digit 7-segment display, then counts minutes and seconds with a blinking colon.

examples.title: Ultrasonic Distance Sensor (HC-SR04)
examples.description: The HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor uses sonar to determine the distance to an object.  This sensor reads from 2cm to 400cm with an accuracy of 0.3cm. In this example, the microcontroller reads the distance from the sensor and displays it on the

drivers.name: BMP280
drivers.description: Temperature and pressure driver for the Bosch BMP280 over I2C or SPI.

drivers.name: DHT11 and DHT22 readings
drivers.description: Temperature and humidity from DHT11 and DHT22 sensors, adding retries, the minimum interval between readings, Fahrenheit and dew point on top of the firmware's dht module.

drivers.name: DS3231 real time clock
drivers.description: Reads and sets the DS3231 real time clock over I2C, including its temperature, and copies the time into the board's own clock.

drivers.name: GY-271 compass (QMC5883L / HMC5883L)
drivers.description: Three axis magnetometer driver for the GY-271 and HW-246 compass modules, detecting whether the board carries a QMC5883L or an HMC5883L.

drivers.name: HC-SR04
drivers.description: Ultrasonic distance driver for the HC-SR04, reading 2cm to 400cm.

drivers.name: I2C character LCD
drivers.description: HD44780 character LCD driver for displays behind a PCF8574 I2C backpack.

drivers.name: IR receiver (NEC remotes)
drivers.description: Decodes NEC infrared remote controls with a three pin 38kHz receiver module such as the CHQ1838, VS1838B or TSOP1838.

drivers.name: IR transmitter (NEC remotes)
drivers.description: Sends NEC infrared remote codes from an IR LED, using the ESP32's RMT peripheral where it exists and a PWM carrier everywhere else.

drivers.name: Matrix keypad
drivers.description: Reads the membrane matrix keypads, 4x4 and 4x3, with debouncing and one report per key press.

drivers.name: MAX7219 LED matrix
drivers.description: Driver for chained MAX7219 8x8 LED matrix modules over SPI, with framebuf drawing and text.

drivers.name: MFRC522 RFID (RC522)
drivers.description: Reads and writes MIFARE Classic cards and tags with an RFID-RC522 reader over SPI.

drivers.name: MPU-6050
drivers.description: Accelerometer, gyroscope and temperature driver for the MPU-6050 over I2C.

drivers.name: P9813 RGB LED driver
drivers.description: Drives chains of P9813 constant current RGB LEDs, as used by chainable RGB LED modules and clocked RGB strips, over a clock and a data pin.

drivers.name: Addressable LEDs (WS2812B / SK6812)
drivers.description: Brightness, gamma and HSV colour layer for WS2812B, WS2811 and SK6812 RGBW strips, on top of the built-in neopixel module.

drivers.name: 74HC595 shift register
drivers.description: Drives one or more chained 74HC595 shift registers from three pins, turning them into eight outputs each.

drivers.name: SSD1306 OLED
drivers.description: Monochrome SSD1306 OLED driver for I2C and SPI, with framebuf drawing primitives.

drivers.name: ST7789 display
drivers.description: Pure MicroPython driver for ST7789 SPI colour displays, with an 8x16 VGA font.

drivers.name: TC74 temperature
drivers.description: Reads whole degrees Celsius from a Microchip TC74 digital temperature sensor over I2C.

drivers.name: TM1637 7-segment display
drivers.description: Driver for TM1637 four digit 7-segment LED display modules, over the chip's own two wire protocol.

drivers.name: VCNL4040 proximity and light
drivers.description: Proximity and ambient light driver for the Vishay VCNL4040, reading lux and a near field proximity count over I2C.

drivers.name: VL6180X range and light
drivers.description: Time of flight distance and ambient light driver for the ST VL6180X, measuring millimetres up to about 20cm.
